mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates sustained monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals labor market stress that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0% (p-value > 0.05 for negative return rate vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Joint increase in housing starts (HOUST > 500) and retail sales (RSAFS > 340000) signals strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns through elevated corporate revenue expectations over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 500 and RSAFS > 340000 (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 220) combined with low interest rates (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) creates stable monetary conditions that support equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 220 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive return rate).
